statements.subject: server
statements.description: Authorization checks MUST occur before any database queries or operations that could leak information about the existence of resources outside the caller's authorization scope
actions: Perform authorization check against caller's authorization boundaries before any database query or resource-accessing operation
Reject request if caller lacks authorization
Proceed with operation only if authorization check passes

statements.subject: server
statements.description: List Tasks: MUST only return tasks visible to the authenticated client according to the agent's authorization model
statements.pre_cond: caller.authenticated = true & authorization_check_complete = true & caller.authorized = true
actions: Scope task result set to caller's authorized access boundaries
Exclude tasks outside caller's authorization scope from response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Get Task: MUST verify the authenticated client has access to the requested task according to the agent's authorization model
actions: Verify authenticated client has access to the specifically requested task per the agent's authorization model

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Task-related operations (Cancel, Subscribe, Push Notification Config): MUST verify the client has appropriate access rights according to the agent's authorization model
actions: Verify client has appropriate access rights per authorization model before executing cancel, subscribe, or push notification config operations
